quranVerse: ﴿وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً﴾
quranVerseTranslation: "And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy."
blessing: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
blessingTranslation: May Allah bless you both, bestow His blessings upon you, and unite you in all goodness.
blessingNote: We ask Allah to bless this union and we are honoured to invite you to share in our joy.
